# Rahnuma

> A working guide to the ILM, PANINI and Zistgah stack: the map of the repositories and their DOIs, exact set-up commands for Linux, WSL and Windows, and the mathematics of encodings, reversible transliteration, Panini's grammar, compilers, hardware and quantum substrates, with every example executed while the guide was built.

© 1993–2026 Abhishek Choudhary. All rights reserved. AyeAI.

- [The whole guide as one Markdown file](rahnuma.md)
- [The guide as a PDF](rahnuma.pdf)
- [The guide as a web page](index.html)
